bayts.text: My ink, my pens, my heart and my body are for an Enricher, the Originator (Al-Badīʿ), Who subjects my times to me.
My gain is a Book that has come to us from Him, firmly established; it came from a Merciful One Who never ceases (to dispense) the good of the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān).
My gratitude, in the two Abodes, is to Allah alone, for him through whom He preserved my heart and my body.
